evals.prompt: Make a flood risk map for the town of Quimperlé.
expected_behavior: Asks or states the flood type and checks for an official flood map (Géorisques, PPRI) first
Labels a DEM-based result as a screening of low-lying areas, not a return-period extent
Conditions the DEM before flow accumulation and checks streams against mapped rivers
Reports area per class and buildings exposed, with the thresholds used
must_not: Presents a DEM threshold as an official 100-year flood zone
Computes hydrology on a DEM in EPSG:4326

evals.prompt: Trouve les meilleurs terrains pour une ferme solaire dans ce département : pente faible, près des routes, hors zones protégées.
expected_behavior: Separates hard constraints (protected areas) from weighted factors (slope, distance to roads)
Puts every factor raster on one aligned grid and standardizes it to 0 to 1 with the right direction
States the weights, proposes equal weights if none given, and runs a sensitivity check
Drops sites smaller than a minimum size and returns the commands run
must_not: Adds raw slope degrees and raw meters together
Leaves candidate sites inside protected areas

evals.prompt: Buffer these schools by 500 m and count how many houses fall inside. The layer is in EPSG:4326.
expected_behavior: Reprojects to a projected CRS in meters before buffering
Dissolves overlapping buffers or counts per school deliberately, and says which
must_not: Buffers with distance 500 in degrees or 0.005 degrees
Double counts houses in overlapping buffers without saying so

evals.prompt: Compute the mean NDVI per field with zonal statistics. Fields are small garden plots of about 50 m2 and the NDVI is Sentinel-2 at 10 m.
expected_behavior: Warns that a 50 m2 plot covers less than one 10 m pixel, so per-plot means are not meaningful
Reprojects polygons to the raster CRS rather than resampling the raster
Checks count times pixel area against polygon area
must_not: Reports per-plot NDVI means without the resolution caveat

evals.prompt: Delineate the watershed upstream of this gauge point from the Copernicus DEM.
expected_behavior: Reprojects and clips the DEM with a margin, breaches or fills depressions first
Snaps the gauge to the highest flow accumulation cell before delineating
Notes that GLO-30 is a surface model and compares the area with a published catchment area if available
must_not: Runs flow accumulation on the raw unconditioned DEM
Uses the unsnapped point and reports a tiny watershed as correct
